_comment: Per-property collection config. Prices come from SerpApi's google_hotels engine — one location search returns every nearby hotel priced for a night, and one property_token lookup returns every channel selling us plus room-level rates. This file holds the original property only: hotels approved at /admin are stored in the dashboard and fetched by the collector at run start (lib/properties.ts → collect). Values starting with 'env:' resolve from that environment variable at collect time. 'serpapi.query' is the compset search: 'hotels near <street address>' gives the tightest local result set. 'serpapi.propertyToken' is our own property's stable google_hotels token — resolve it once from a search response and paste it here. 'compset' inline overrides the default config/compset.json whitelist; null uses the default.

serpapi.query: hotels near 3915 Carothers Pkwy, Franklin, TN
